page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No marginal notes. Running head at top right with the page number. Catchword at the bottom right. Signature at the foot.

main_text.p: pellare audent, qui contra Me & Leges, nec minùs Iuramenta fua Religionémque pugnantes occubuerunt.

Probè verò intelligunt Boni Christiani, iis duntaxat inclytum hoc Nomen tribui, qui Dei veritatem & quæ speciatim hîc debent officia vitâ fuâ habent potiora, cæterisque in Mundo charissimis; qui nil fibi privatim è rebus novis quærentes id solum piè cogitabant, quibus a-nimarum vinculis, Deo, Mihi, & Ec-clesiæ, obligati erant in obsequium fi-mul, & auxilium.

Deus suâ misericordiâ potuit donare, & donavit procul dubio multos vitâ æ-ternâ qui in justa causa obierunt. ipso il-lo corporum interitu in Salutem Animarum Sanctificato, vulneribusque & clade tem-porali viam quasi ad æternam felicitatem siernente[?]; dum certa mortis approxima-tio ita corda eorum in eam fidei dispo-neret humilitatis, pœnitentiæ capacitatem, quæ justissimæ causæ conjuncta in meliorem multo vitâ præpararet, quàm vel nefarii illis hostes adimere, vel sibi ipsis sine pœnitentia sperare potuerant.

page.notes: The left edge carries shadows and fragments of the neighbouring page; these are not transcribed. "siernente" is uncertain in the scan (probably "tendente"), so it is marked [?]. The bottom gathering mark "I 3" is read with some doubt. Printed spelling kept throughout, including "fua", "fi-mul" and "ipsis". The page number 173 is printed at top right.
